problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — Singasandra (2019–2021)
problem_summary: 8 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in Singasandra between February 2019 and November 2021, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 88% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.
representative_subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 19 pothole complaints.
9 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹3.8 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).
Ward recorded 178 road crashes in 2024, of which 42 were fatal.

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 88% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
HYPOTHESIS (unverified): 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after being marked resolved. This may indicate short-term or superficial repairs that did not address the underlying problem.
agency_attribution_note: 8 of 8 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier HIGH (score=0.58). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, crash_risk=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.88.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Singasandra' matched to datameet243=234 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.542).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Singasandra for the period 2019–2021.
Request inspection records for the 9 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 1 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
